judged_text: The migration interpolates the stored `embeddable_hosts` site-setting value unescaped into a SQL INSERT statement (`VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`), turning admin-set configuration data into raw SQL. The old `embeddable_hosts` setting was free-text (`host_list`) that accepted arbitrary strings (the removed code even tolerated full URLs like 'http://eviltrout.com'), so any stored value containing a single quote aborts the upgrade with a SQL syntax error, and a crafted stored value executes arbitrary SQL with full database privileges during migration — the config-backed-sink threat model treats this admin/API-writable setting as attacker-controllable input.
